scope: Each TRAIN scene optimized independently using its full future only to create an offline label; future trajectory is not a model input or deployment signal.

protocol.position_constraint: ready-event prediction residual RMSE <= the same scene's C5 baseline residual RMSE
protocol.task_objective: frozen-state SO3 geodesic RMSE over 20,000 1-ms filter outputs; exact locked filter and reference-derived task target
protocol.optimizer: projected gradient, 15 steps maximum, step 0.02, up to 9 feasibility backtracking attempts
